title: Twin Channel Washer
pages: Craft the controller with sealed steel plate, water buckets, copper ingots and iron bars. Set it over stone bricks. Place copper blocks east and west, iron bars at the four level diagonal corners, and source water above both the north and south adjacent spaces. Extend two blocks east and west from the controller with a hopper at each end and a stone-brick support directly below each hopper.

Right-click the formed washer holding a complete matching batch to load one arcana_industry:channel_washing recipe. The controller finishes it after 40 ticks; collect the buffered result with an empty hand. Gravel yields flint, sand yields clay balls, cobblestone wears to gravel and soul sand rinses to soul soil. Missing either source, the bed, a copper bank, an iron brace or a supported settling hopper stops processing without consuming items.

Four raw gold washed together concentrate into one Panned Concentrate. Two concentrate craft the Rotary Screen, whose Screened Silica is required for the Electrolyzer. The washer uses its own datapack recipe type exclusively; ordinary Ore Sluice sluicing recipes do not run here. The two end hoppers are required settling drains; they do not feed the controller. Feed it with a separate hopper or pipe on the controller as described below.

Soil batches: coarse dirt rinses to dirt, rooted dirt releases hanging roots, dirt hydrates into mud, mud settles into clay, and packed mud softens back to mud. Four bricks blocks reclaim sixteen clay balls, matching sixteen clay balls annealed into brick items and pressed into those blocks; four terracotta rinse into eight reusable brick items; clay blocks break into clay balls. Feed four of the named input item for each batch.

Recovery batches: rinse prismarine into shards, sea lanterns into crystals, glowstone into dust, magma blocks into magma cream, red mushroom blocks into mushrooms, cobwebs into string and oak leaves into sticks. These recipes reclaim materials from built or gathered blocks. All 20 channel_washing recipes are data-pack entries. Hand feeding and port automation both work; a full input buffer refuses another hand-fed batch without taking it.
Four sea lanterns rinse into twenty prismarine crystals (five per lantern). Crystal-to-lantern machines require at least five crystals per lantern, so recovery cannot multiply the input.

For automation, insert valid channel_washing stock into the controller from any face except the bottom and extract products from the bottom. Each formed batch takes 40 ticks; a missing water source, bed, copper bank, iron brace or settling hopper pauses processing without consuming stock. The controller buffers one input stack and one output stack, saves both and its face modes, and exposes Forge item handlers to hoppers or pipes; stock with no matching recipe is refused. Sneak-right-click with an empty hand to cycle the clicked face through input, output and disabled; right-click with an empty hand to collect buffered output. It has no FE or fluid port. Matching ties resolve by resource ID.
